facts.claim: Explorer of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 2000; 142,000 GT; 3250 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 348 m length; Voyager class.
Explorer of the Seas is filled with unforgettable activities and features from bow to stern. Explorer of the Seas is one of the coolest culture-cruising ships out there.
Put thrilling adventures back on your radar onboard the wow-worthy Explorer of the Seas®.
Explorer of the Seas is a Voyager-class cruise ship owned and operated by Royal Caribbean International, completed in 2000.

catalogSpecs.description: Voyager-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2000; 142,000 GT; approx. 3,250 guests at double occupancy.
